svg.text: BOKI / MODELING HANDOFF V2 · PROPOSED ART SPEC

Fused fingers + simple thumb; no teeth, eyes or

Keep negative space between arms and torso in
Do not simulate cloth or add hair/fur systems.
Collider footprint needs route testing; silhouette
No death clip or kill reward: Guilt is
Generic rig first for bespoke jam
Optional Socket_Warning at chest for presentation only.
Guilt root movement remains separate from its skeletal pose.
Decorative boss-shadow object has no chase AI.
Unity +X right / +Y up / +Z forward · meters · all new art sizes and budgets are proposals.
Generated artwork is raster reference; notes/diagrams are editable vectors. Meshes, rigs and integration are future work.
Canonical rules: docs/Story.md + docs/Gameplay.md · practical import and wiring: UNITY_HANDOFF.md
